top_signals.title: It's Not Time to Raise Rates, Says State Street's Hung
top_signals.summary: State Street Investment Management President and CEO Yie-Hsin Hung says gold and private markets are anchoring many portfolios. Hung says the US economy is in good shape and the Federal Reserve should not raise interest rates this year. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: ADNOC Gas Unveils $8.2 Billion Expansion Push
top_signals.summary: ADNOC Gas, the gas business of the Emirati energy major, will spend more than $8 billion on its Rich Gas Development project, the company said today, as it eyes 60% growth in its earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization by 2030. The Rich Gas Development project covers several gas production facilities, including the Habshah gas project, which is the UAE’s largest gas processing facility, and the Ruwais LNG project, also in the UAE. top_signals.title: Bullish Oil Bets Shrink for a Second Week Running, COT Data Show
top_signals.summary: Money managers have reduced their bullish bets on both Brent and WTI crude futures over the past two weeks despite little progress on a potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. In the latest reporting week to August 4, portfolio managers trimmed their net long position in NYMEX WTI by 7,257 lots to 101,050 lots, data from the exchanges found. The net long position, the difference between bullish and bearish bets, in ICE Brent crude oil futures was slashed by 11%, or by 20,361 lots to 164,722 lots.
